journey.name: custom fee confirmation estimate
journey.description: Verifies that a custom on-chain fee shows the confirmation time of the fee tier it reaches, the same text the preset speeds use, instead of "Depends on the fee". Preconditions: a synced regtest wallet with at least 30,000 confirmed sats in Savings and the current fee tiers loaded. The custom rate of 50 ₿/vbyte is above the regtest backend's Fast tier; on a backend whose Fast tier is higher, use a rate above it.

actions.action: Start an on-chain send of 5,000 sats from Savings to a fresh regtest address and reach the confirmation screen (testTag "SendConfirmContent")
Open the speed picker by tapping the Speed and Fee value, then tap Custom (testTag "fee_CUSTOM_button")
On the custom fee screen (testTag "fee_screen"), clear the field with Remove (testTag "NRemove") and enter 50 with the number pad (testTags "N5", "N0"), then tap Continue (testTag "continue_btn")
Back on confirmation with details shown, verify Speed and Fee reads Custom and Confirming In reads "±10-20 minutes", the Fast speed's time, not "Depends on the fee"
